name: Wren Ashby
physicalDescription: Slight and freckled, with dark hair cropped short and a watchful look.
personality: Stubborn, practical, and quick to notice when someone is lying. Hides worry behind briskness. Keeps her promises and expects others to keep theirs.

voice.description: Clear and brisk, a little hoarse from travel; softens only with people she trusts.
